_comment: P50 attack-window golden vectors (T. ruling 25.11.: hero and Imperial activations INTERLEAVE, so a damage group with a hero ring believed in its OWN zone is attackable NOW and must not cool in the tail slot while the heroes shoot it untouched; a candidate that cannot reach anyone still goes last - the heroes must cross open ground to reach it). Hand-pinned LAWS (the law IS the expectation, SectionsAttackWindow.cs - never --record): ring on the candidate's zone -> it stays at its ring-lifted rank with tag attack_window; ring elsewhere, no feed, empty feed or unknown own zone -> the canon tail pull stands, bit-identical to finisher_last law; the woundAll counter law (freshest damage in the last slot) outranks the window. Roster is fixed in code: FIN (DG021 Tusken Raider, Red+Green) prints the higher damage EV x vitality and IS the finisher candidate (premise check in the runner); WEAK (DG009 Royal Guard, Red+Yellow) sits in ZX; the candidate's zone is ZR unless fin_zone_unknown.
